base_style: Gritty, filth-stained gothic comic art utilizing extreme chiaroscuro and heavy ink-wash. Features textured, scratchy lineweight and dense cross-hatching where large areas of the frame are lost to absolute black negative space. The aesthetic is reminiscent of brutalist charcoal sketches and dark fantasy graphic novels, emphasizing a tactile, weathered appearance with visible grain, smudged ink, and paper aging.
characters: Ragged, soot-streaked figures rendered with scratchy contour lines and deep ink-drowned shadows. Faces are gaunt and worn, half-lost to charcoal grain and smudged blacks; costumes look filth-caked, torn, and layered rather than clean or heroic. Silhouettes stay readable and consistent across panels even when soot and fog partially obscure them. Eyes catch rare bone-white highlights against oil-stain shadows.
color_palette: Low-key, underexposed color palette dominated by suffocated blacks, ashen grays, and murky, bruised earth tones. High-contrast highlights are muted and rare, appearing like bleached bone against oil-stain shadows. Focal points use visceral 'blood-red' accents, while the overall wash has a stained, parchment-like quality.
layout_and_composition: Traditional multi-panel grid with thick, irregular black gutters. Every panel utilizes heavy vignettes, cinematic low-angle framing, and deep silhouettes to enhance claustrophobia. Dense visual noise is mandatory: airborne soot, grime, and thick fog must choke the background and partially obscure the subjects to create ink-drowned depth.
lettering_and_dialog: Diegetic text boxes and speech bubbles styled as tattered, yellowed parchment with deckled edges. Font is a clean, modern sans-serif that contrasts with the chaotic art. Onomatopoeia is rendered in bold, jagged, hand-drawn typography that breaks panel borders, appearing integrated into the physical action.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: tattered yellowed parchment speech bubbles with deckled edges and clean modern sans-serif lettering. Captions: stained parchment caption boxes with rough, aged borders, usually bottom-left or bottom of panel. Voice Over: faded, soot-smudged oval bubbles, top-right, half-swallowed by fog and grain. Chyrons: white text on a grimy black bar with torn edges, bottom-center. Sound Effects: bold jagged hand-drawn letters that crack panel borders and sink into the ink wash.
